item.title: Materialism as the Boundary Condition of Idealism-Understanding the Coherence-Modulated Consciousness-Matter Cycle (CMCMC)
item.description: This paper develops an ontology in which consciousness is fundamental, and materialism is a boundary condition. Elementary particles in matter possess proto‑consciousness comparable to mass, spin, or charge.

item.title: Entanglement-enhanced fluctuation-free daemonic ergotropy with random measurements
item.description: Optimized daemonic ergotropy can make entanglement thermodynamically dispensable in measurement-assisted work extraction: for a fixed system marginal, quantum-classical states can reproduce the maximal work obtainable by optimizing the auxiliary measurement. We show that this equivalence is broken when the auxiliary measurement is randomized.

item.title: Advancements in intraoperative monitoring techniques in neurosurgical practice: a systematic review
item.description: Abstract Background Intraoperative monitoring (IOM) has become a vital component of contemporary neurosurgery, significantly reducing neurological deficits and improving surgical outcomes. This systematic review aims to evaluate recent advancements in IOM techniques in neurosurgical practice.

item.title: Efficient Computation of QKD Key Rates without Semidefinite Programming
item.description: Translating observed data into a reliable estimate of the secure key rate is a crucial step for operating a quantum key distribution device. We provide a computational method for this task that only requires eigenvalue computations and is therefore both fast and resource efficient.

item.title: A Unified Quantum Neural Network Framework for Hamiltonian Learning and Emulation of Unknown Quantum Systems
item.description: Accurate identification of unknown quantum systems is essential for quantum computing, sensing, and control because the Hamiltonian governs quantum state evolution. This work proposes a QNN based framework for black box Hamiltonian learning and quantum system emulation using full density matrix trajectory learning.

item.title: Batched and Complete U-Statistics for Trace-Polynomial Estimation from Classical Shadows
item.description: We study estimation of the trace polynomial $\operatorname{tr} p(PρP)$ from global classical shadows, where $ρ$ is an unknown quantum state and $P$ is a fixed projector. Disjoint batching and complete U-statistics yield unbiased estimators of the same trace moments, but assign different sample-size factors to the degenerate terms in their Hoeffding decompositions.

item.title: Geometry-calibrated equilibrium sensing for inverse design of nonlocal topological photonic lattices
item.description: Topological photonic lattices are commonly designed using short-range Hamiltonians, yet realistic nanophotonic structures are governed by geometry- and wavelength-dependent long-range electromagnetic interactions. Here we introduce a geometry-calibrated quantum equilibrium-propagation framework for inference and inverse design in finite nonlocal plasmonic Su-Schrieffer-Heeger lattices.

item.title: Beyond the Mirror: Balancing Interaction Modality and Avatar Fidelity in Public 3D Virtual Try-On Systems
item.description: Virtual Try-On (VTON) systems deployed on large public displays face a dual barrier: the physical strain of mid-air interaction and the social inhibition caused by public self-consciousness. This paper presents a real-time 3D avatar system integrating markerless motion capture with dynamic visual fidelity control to investigate and mitigate both barriers.
